leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a reactive date state using Vue's ref() function
Bind the date state to a DatePicker component using v-model
Configure a DatePicker component with controlled properties and event handlers
Implement a handler function to update the date state when the user selects a date
Render the current selected date in the UI by accessing the reactive state
Manipulate the date state programmatically to reset or set default values
Integrate the controlled DatePicker within a form component while maintaining reactivity
